meta.basis: The Gloria is sung by all standing on Sundays outside Advent and Lent and on solemnities and feasts (GIRM 43, 53, 126), so the card is a feast: six candles (GIRM 117), flowers around the altar rather than on it (GIRM 305). Its opening words are the angels' song at Bethlehem (Luke 2:14), painted as a fresco in the church's vault rather than as a vision.
